name: Welcome
subject: Welcome to Genova
description: Sent when a parent creates an account on the website.

name: Subscription confirmation and receipt
subject: Your Genova receipt
description: Sent after a successful Paystack payment.

name: Expiration and amount due
subject: Your Genova Premium needs renewing
description: Sent when a payment fails or a subscription is about to lapse.

name: Payment failed
subject: We could not take your Genova payment
description: Sent when a renewal payment does not go through.

name: Cancellation
subject: Your Genova subscription was cancelled
description: Sent when a subscription is cancelled.

name: New title release
subject: New on Genova: Luna and the Firefly
description: Announce a new or upcoming story.

name: Admin broadcast
subject: A message from Genova
description: Free-form message to a group of parents.

name: Passcode or password changed
subject: Your Genova passcode was changed
description: Sent when a parent changes their passcode or password.

name: Renewal coming up
subject: Your Genova Premium renews on 9 January 2027
description: Sent a few days before an active subscription renews (scheduled reminder).

name: Premium ending (cancelled)
subject: Your Genova Premium ends on 9 January 2027
description: Sent a few days before a cancelled subscription runs out (scheduled reminder).

name: Last chance to renew
subject: Last chance to keep Genova Premium
description: Sent when the 5-day grace period after a missed payment is about to end (scheduled reminder).

name: Support message received
subject: We have your message
description: Sent to a parent right after they contact support.
